flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/PS/form/PSForm.tsx, utils/data/LinkData.tsx, utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts, pages/NoticeUPL (UPL-only endorsement); ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/helpers/PermanentSuspensionHelper. No work item/endorsement for PS in the six repos
note: Story status 'No requirement' (requirement not given). The permanent suspension takes effect immediately on submit (POST staff-apply-suspension changes VON, eVON, suspended_notice) with no work item or supervisor approval. Synonyms tried in the UI and both APIs: work_item, workitem, work-item, WorkItem, supervisor, endorse, approval. The only 'workitem' is the UPL notice endorsement flow in the UI; its 'workitem' endpoint has no controller in the six repos (cannot verify if it lives elsewhere) and the Work Items menu is commented out. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Not claimed: there is no work item or supervisor endorsement code for permanent suspension.

steps.step: After the permanent suspension, OCMS creates a work item holding the suspended notices
steps.detail: The PS flow only calls staff-apply-suspension and re-reads the notices (PSForm.tsx:149-182); the server only changes VON, eVON, suspended_notice and the refund when applicable (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:138-158). No work item is created. grep work_item/workitem/work-item/WorkItem in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi (src/main) finds no work item entity, repository, or controller for PS.

steps.step: The work item is routed to the supervisor's dashboard
steps.detail: The 'Work Items' menu exists in Meta (utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts:1-11) but its menu push is commented out under the '//! UNCONFIRMED' marker (utils/data/LinkData.tsx:396-398), and there is no work item page/route component or supervisor dashboard in ocmsadminui. No supervisor-based routing was found.

steps.step: The supervisor endorses the permanent suspension from the dashboard
steps.detail: The existing endorsement is only for UPL notices (constant 'UPL Endorsement', utils/constant.ts:301-302; hook useEndorsement.tsx:56 calls the 'workitem' endpoint), not for permanent suspension. That 'workitem' endpoint has no controller in the six repos; cannot verify if it exists in another system. The PS flow has no 'pending endorsement' status.
